entry.title: [NEWS] Windows 11 is collecting data on which coding agents and developer tools you use
[NEWS] Elevated errors on claude.ai, Claude Code, and platform.claude.com
[NEW] an `esc to stop` footer hint in a subagent's view where Esc would stop it
entry.content:
Try: ~/.codex/config.toml → [features] multi_agent = true, hooks = true

Parallel subagents and lifecycle hooks, the same shape as Claude Code's.

entry.title: [NEW] Codex 0.169.0: The opt-in terminal workspace supports multiple side-chat tabs. Switch between them with the keyboard or mouse, and reopen saved local side chats after restarting Co
entry.content: Search older tasks from the agent command center by name, prompt preview, or working directory. · Turn on **Collapse turn details** in the full-screen transcript to fold completed activity beneath each prompt while keeping answers visible and tool output searchable.
